_note: Pulse is an edited periodical, not a feed of user activity. There is no member count, no reaction count and no leaderboard — those fields do not exist in this model on purpose. Submissions are never published unreviewed.

invitation.headline: There is no community activity to show you yet, so we are not going to fake any.
invitation.body: PerlCoders relaunched in 2026. Rather than render empty forum categories or a zero next to a heart icon, here is what actually helps right now.

actions.label: Ask a question
actions.note: Answered in a Pulse issue or as a guide, with attribution if you want it.

actions.label: Submit a correction
actions.note: Especially on anything the Timeline marks unverified.

actions.label: Submit an artifact
actions.note: Old scripts, screenshots, mailing-list captures — with rights information.

issues.title: Pulse 01 — Relaunch
issues.summary: What this publication is, what it will not do, and the three things we most need help with.

entries.title: What changed, and who we are not
entries.body: PerlCoders relaunched under new ownership in 2026. We are not the former PerlCoders company, we do not claim its credits or its clients, and we do not sell or support its software. The Archive exists so that inbound links from the old catalogue land somewhere honest instead of a 404 or a sales page.

entries.title: Fifteen Timeline entries are marked unverified
entries.body: Every event on the Timeline carries a verification state. The ones marked unverified are plausible but unsourced — we would rather show you that than launder a guess into a fact. If you can point at a primary source for any of them, that is the single most useful thing you can send us.

entries.title: TotalAVS Pro: we have a name and a URL and nothing else
entries.body: One Archive entry has no established purpose. We are not going to invent one. Documentation, a dated capture, or a screenshot with rights information would close it.

entries.title: Code examples are not yet CI-tested
entries.body: The examples on this site are written to be read and were not executed by an automated harness for this build. The `codeTested` field says false everywhere it is false, and the evidence strip on the homepage will stay in its pending state until a real run exists.
